entities.name: Benzyl-protected scaffold
observations: Contains an O-benzyl substituent (OCH2Ph) and a difluorobenzyl amide; the polycyclic core is otherwise retained.
Source search identifies this as the starting material for the MeOH/Pd transformation.

entities.name: O-benzyl hydrogenolysis
observations: Methanol with palladium catalyst effects cleavage of the aryl-O-CH2Ph benzyl ether, replacing OCH2Ph with OH.
Core carbonyls, fluorine substituents, and difluorobenzyl amide are reported to remain unchanged.

entities.name: Debenzylated product
observations: This is the starting scaffold with the O-benzyl group converted to the corresponding hydroxyl group.
